housing.text: Introduced legislation requiring larger cities and counties to create centralized online application portals for housing development projects.
housing.quote: A city or county with a population of 150,000 or more persons shall, no later than January 1, 2028, make a centralized application portal available on its internet website to applicants for housing development projects.

schools.text: Caloza supports investing in public schools, teacher and school staff wages, early childhood education, and related programs.
schools.quote: Jessica believes public education is the key to unlocking opportunity and building a brighter future for all Californians

immigration.text: Supported legislation requiring government agencies to identify and equip privately rented vehicles used for enforcement, citing concerns about excessive force and due process during immigration operations.
immigration.quote: Fear for the public and fear for those who are being illegally faced with excessive force from our Federal Government without due process.

abortion.text: Caloza supports protecting Planned Parenthood funding and expanding access to reproductive health care.
abortion.quote: In the Assembly, Jessica has fought to protect funding for Planned Parenthood and expand access to critical health care services for all women.

tax.text: She supports lowering taxes to encourage people to spend more and foster state growth.
tax.quote: Lower taxes. People will spend the money saved and thus foster growth in the state.

immigration.text: She says California should cooperate with federal agents enforcing immigration law rather than oppose them.
immigration.quote: The least we can do is cooperate with them rather than threaten them.

health.text: She says returning to private health businesses would reduce the problem of people lacking health insurance and save government money.
health.quote: If we went back to private health businesses, the problem would diminish and the government would save a lot of money.

energy.text: She opposes ending oil production in California and says nuclear power is safe and inexpensive.
energy.quote: Nuclear power is safe and cheap.
